content:
Amazon has refreshed its fall early Prime Day deals with new additions. We continue to see the steady $50 price drop on AirPods Pro 3, but leading the day is the brand new M5 Max Mac Studio with its first $50 discount. Alongside the new launch deal on Beats 360 over-ear headphones, Powerbeats Pro 2 is also $50 off (or up to $116 off at Best Buy in open-box condition), and a two-pack of Beats 5-foot braided USB-C cables is just $14 with Prime shipping. Those join the latest wireless Ring Battery Doorbell 2K down at 60% off to $40, loads of iPhone 18 Pro case exclusives, chargers, and more below.

Score $50 off AirPods Pro 3 to pair with your iPhone 18 Pro and Apple Watch

One of the best fall early Prime Day deals around right now is $50 off Apple’s latest flagship AirPods Pro 3. Pairing perfectly with the new iPhone 18 Pro, Apple Watch Series 12, and Ultra 4 now on shelves, AirPods Pro 3 are the best way to upgrade the entire experience.

Amazon is currently shipping the Apple AirPods Pro 3 for $199 with free delivery.

Down from the usual $249 price tag, the $50 discount lands a hair below Best Buy and is the best deal available to anyone we’ve found right now.

Apple just released the all-new AirPods 5 starting at $129, now for the first time with ANC active noise cancellation. But if you’re looking for 3x the noise cancellation, a wireless charging case, longer battery life, and a built-in heart rate sensor in a flagship experience, the AirPods Pro 3 are the way to go. The AirPods 5 with wireless charging case can be had for as low as $149, but you miss out on the fully sealed noise cancellation and extras that come with the Pro line.

One thing to note though — this is an ongoing price drop that will carry into the fall early Prime Day event. That could potentially mean Amazon drops the price even further when the official Prime Big Deal Days kick off on October 6 (or earlier). We have seen Amazon take the price down to $189 and $179, and even $169 during the summer Prime Day event. The fall event two weeks from now is likely to repeat that trend, but there’s no guarantee, and the $169 deal has been hit or miss on stock.

Apple’s brand new 2026 M5 Max Mac Studio now $50 off at Amazon

In addition to the return of launch deals on the previously released M6 Mac mini, those looking to upgrade to Apple’s newly released and more powerful 2026 Mac Studio can now do so at a new low price at Amazon.

Amazon is currently shipping the brand new M5 Max Mac Studio with 36GB of RAM and 512GB of storage for $2,449 with free delivery.

Normally fetching $2,499, this configuration is now $50 off. It’s not the largest discount, but if you’re looking to get yours sooner rather than later, you might as well pocket that $50 — it even beats the preorder deal by a dollar.

  • 2026 Mac Studio M5 Max 36GB/512GB $2,450 (reg. $2,499)

Either way, early buyers are saving some cash, and for those who don’t need the power of the M5 Max and 36GB of memory, the previous M6 Mac mini deals are back live on some models:

  • 2026 Mac mini M6 16GB/256GB $880 (reg. $899)
  • 2026 Mac mini M6 16GB/512GB $1,070 (reg. $1,099)
  • 2026 Mac mini M6 24GB/512GB $1,270 (reg. $1,299)

Powerbeats Pro 2 now $50 off at Amazon or up to $116 off open-box at Best Buy

Alongside the ongoing AirPods Pro 3 deal and the launch discount on the new Beats 360 over-ear headphones, Amazon is also discounting the latest Beats Powerbeats Pro 2 by $50. Over at Best Buy, open-box options in “excellent” condition can be had for even more off.

Amazon is currently shipping the latest Powerbeats Pro 2 for $199.95 with free delivery, and all four colors are in stock.

Down from the $250 list price, the $50 discount matches the lows we’ve mentioned before. The price has only gone lower a time or two in the past, and today’s deal on the brand new set is just $20 shy of Amazon’s all-time low.

Over at Best Buy, there are some “excellent” condition open-box options that go even lower than Amazon — all four colors are now more than $100 off the new list price, or pretty close to it:

  • Powerbeats Pro 2 Hyper Purple $134 (reg. $250 new)
  • Powerbeats Pro 2 Quick Sand $138 (reg. $250 new)
  • Powerbeats Pro 2 Jet Black $146 (reg. $250 new)
  • Powerbeats Pro 2 Electric Orange $152 (reg. $250 new)

But if you’re looking to score the brand new Beats 360 over-ear headphones, you’ll want to act quickly, as you can still grab the modular Beats 360 Cushion Kit for 20% off during the launch period.

  • Beats 360 over-ear headphones $350
  • Beats 360 Cushion Kit $10 (reg. $50)

9to5 readers’ exclusive iPhone 18 Pro case deals: leather, metal, wood, faux suede, and more

Latest wireless Ring Battery Doorbell 2K drops to $40 in mega deal (60% off, all-time low)

The fall early Prime Big Deal Days event has added even more new offers. We previously highlighted the all-time low $100 price drop on the latest Ring 4K smart doorbell, and Amazon is now taking 60% off the latest wireless Ring Battery Doorbell 2K, dropping it to just $40.

Amazon is currently shipping the latest Ring Battery Doorbell 2K for $39.99 with free delivery.

This model launched earlier this spring at $100 and is now $60 off, making for a 60% discount that’s the lowest we’ve tracked. Before this, we’d only seen $50 price drops during the summer Prime Day event and a few smaller markdowns around $70, none of which compare to today’s price cut.

With more than a week to go until the official October 6 fall Prime Day event, this model — like its higher-end 4K counterpart — is already seeing solid discounts. Further price drops are unlikely, though not entirely impossible.

If you’re looking to upgrade to the 4K model, both the wireless and wired versions are now sitting at the lowest prices we’ve tracked:

  • Ring Battery Doorbell 4K Pro $150 (reg. $250)
  • Ring Wired Doorbell 4K Pro $150 (reg. $250)
